hints: List a few sensible moves; do they differ much?
If several are about equal, choose by your plan and move on.
Any of Qe3, Kb1, g4, c5, Qf2, Qe1 is accepted.
items.explain: 6 moves (Qe3, Kb1, g4, c5, Qf2, Qe1) are within 40 centipawns of the engine's first choice and no line wins more than a pawn (checked, depth 16). Any of them is fine: a long think here buys nothing.

items.prompt: White to move. Nxd5 wins a pawn on the count; Nh4 is quiet. Which gives the better position?

claims.statement: Nh4 is the engine's first choice (depth 16).
Nxd5 is at least 230 centipawns worse than the best move (depth 16).
Nxd5 wins at least a pawn along the engine's best line.
Nh4 leaves material level along the engine's best line.

hints: The count is only the first step. What does the pawn-winning move do to the rest of the position?
Picture each end position, not each move.
The quiet move, Nh4, is better.
items.explain: The engine prefers Nh4 and rates Nxd5 at least 230 centipawns worse (checked, depth 16), although Nxd5 wins at least a pawn along the engine's best line (checked). Counting material alone would have chosen the wrong move.
